paite: Ka mangbatna ah TOUPA ka sam a, huchi in ama'n ahon dawng hi.
heading: Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

paite: TOUPA aw, muk zuautheite lak leh lei mikhemhat lak ah ka hinna humbit in.
english: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

paite: Nang lei khemhat, na kiang ah bang ahon pe ding ua, bang ahon behlap ding ua?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

paite: Mihat thal zumtakte, Juniper sing lingte toh.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

paite: Mashekte gam a ka omleh Kedarte puanin lak a ka om ka tung agik hi.
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

paite: Lemna hote kiang ah ka hinna sawtpi a-omta hi.
english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

paite: Ke'n kituah ka ut a; himahleh thu ka gentak in kidou a-ut nak uhi.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
